objectives.title: Governance health
objectives.statement: Watch the health of governance itself, through measures that show when controls are failing.
objectives.metric: Share of governance measures reported on time
tiers: The sandbox is reviewed each quarter.
Measures for each discipline are reported each quarter.
Measures are reported each month, with thresholds that trigger review.
Measures are reported to the governance council each month.
objectives.evidence: The governance measures and their history.

objectives.title: Maturity assessment
objectives.statement: Assess the maturity of governance regularly, to find gaps and improve.
tiers: No assessment is required for the sandbox alone.
Maturity is assessed each year.
Maturity is assessed each year by someone outside the governance team.
Maturity is assessed each year by an outside party.
objectives.evidence: The assessment reports and the actions taken.

objectives.title: Comparison with others
objectives.statement: Compare governance practice with published practice elsewhere, to find improvements.
tiers: No comparison is required.
Practice is compared with published guidance each year.
Practice is compared with peers each year.
The comparison is reported to the governance council with a plan.
objectives.evidence: The comparison and the plan that followed.

objectives.title: The framework kept current
objectives.statement: Revise the organization's framework when technology, threats or the business change, and record what changed and why.
objectives.metric: Time since the last framework revision
tiers: The sandbox rules are revised when needed.
The framework is reviewed each year.
The framework is reviewed each year and after any serious incident.
Framework revisions are approved by the governance council.
objectives.evidence: The framework's version history with reasons.

objectives.title: Lessons learned
objectives.statement: Capture lessons from incidents and audits, and feed them back into Design and Build, so that mistakes are not repeated.
objectives.metric: Share of incidents with a lesson captured and acted on
tiers: The builder notes what went wrong.
Each incident has a written lesson.
Each lesson leads to a change in a standard, a test or a control, or a recorded reason for none.
Lessons are shared across business units and reviewed by the governance council.
objectives.evidence: The lessons log and the changes it led to.

objectives.title: Governance as code
objectives.statement: Turn controls into code where they can be, so that they are applied the same way every time and produce their own evidence.
objectives.risk: Manual governance that slows work and varies
objectives.metric: Share of controls enforced and evidenced by code
tiers: Sandbox limits are enforced by the platform.
Release gates are automated.
Run-time limits on identity, reach, spend and stopping are enforced by code outside the agent.
Policies are written as code, versioned and reviewed like any other change.
objectives.evidence: The list of controls with how each is enforced, and the policy code's history.

objectives.title: The loop from Change back to Design
objectives.statement: Make sure what is learned at Run and Change reaches Design and Build: incidents, evaluation results, cost findings and partner feedback each lead to a change, a new control or a recorded decision to leave things as they are.
objectives.risk: The same problems built into the next version
objectives.metric: Share of run-time findings that reached a design or build decision
tiers: The builder carries findings into the next experiment.
Findings are recorded against the agent and reviewed at the next release.
Each finding is linked to the design or build change it caused, or to a decision not to change.
The loop is reviewed each quarter by the governance council across all Tier 4 agents.
objectives.evidence: Findings linked to the changes or decisions that followed them.
